name: Wills, estate and end-of-life documents
one_line: A protection-first situation for a person's testamentary, trust, delegated-authority, advance-care, beneficiary-direction and closely related estate-administration records. It recognizes wills, codicils, trust instruments, powers of attorney, advance directives, designation forms, grants and estate packets without deciding legal validity, current effect, ownership, capacity, inheritance rights or medical wishes; Legal remains field-less and recommends no automatic folder depth.
design_cite: 00 names Legal's posture, not this narrower situation: “Finance, identity, medical, and legal material should be implemented first as safety domains, meaning the system detects and protects them before any cloud or automated placement decision is allowed.” It permits a lone legal document to surface safely: “Rare but sensitive files such as passports, visas, and legal documents may be surfaced as protected records even when they do not meet a normal group-size threshold.” It names the broad residual home: “Protected Records may represent sensitive isolated material such as passport scans, medical documents, account statements, visas, legal forms, or credentials; it should normally remain local-only and must not cause filenames or content to be exposed in model prompts.” The estate-planning boundary and every instrument-specific signal below are inference, not attributed to 00.

deterministic: PRECONDITION: these structures select a protected Legal situation only. They do not prove that an instrument is valid, operative, current, unrevoked, enforceable or complete, and they license no Legal fact because the schema declares no fields under D1 and PR-6. P7 classification precedes every model or placement path: “Privacy policy must be enforced before content reaches any model or external connector.”

a completed will structure whose title or page-one heading identifies a testamentary instrument and whose own body contains a named maker or testator role, an executor or personal-representative designation, dispositive clauses, and an execution or attestation block. The combination is the signal; the word will, a person's name, or signatures alone is not

a codicil, amendment, restatement or revocation whose own heading identifies the instrument, whose body directly references a parent will or trust, and whose execution or attestation block is present. The reference supports a candidate version relationship only; it does not establish which instrument governs

a completed trust instrument whose heading identifies a trust deed, declaration, agreement, amendment or certification and whose labelled or operative structure distinguishes a settlor or grantor, trustee and beneficiary role alongside directions for holding or administering property. Those roles remain observations, and a trust-titled account statement is not the instrument

a completed delegated-authority instrument whose own title identifies a power of attorney or functional equivalent and whose structure distinguishes the principal or donor from the attorney or agent, states an authority scope, and carries an execution, witness, certification or registration block. These terms are proposed contextual vocabulary for R6, not a universal legal rule

a completed advance-directive or living-will structure whose own title is health-specific and whose body names the person making the directive, states treatment preferences or appoints a health-care agent, and carries an execution, witness or notarial block. The same file may activate Medical protection on independent clinical evidence, but the directive never becomes a medical fact

a completed beneficiary-designation, payable-on-death or transfer-on-death record whose issuer-labelled account or plan slot co-occurs with primary or contingent beneficiary slots and an owner authorization or execution block. The account and plan structure may activate Finance independently; the designation does not prove entitlement, currency or consistency with any will

an official estate-administration record whose heading identifies a grant, representation or administration function and whose labelled structure names a deceased person or estate, a personal representative, a court or registry, and a grant or proceeding reference. Jurisdiction-specific document names are candidate values supplied later, never fields or universal requirements

an estate inventory or account whose own heading names an estate, whose rows distinguish assets, liabilities, receipts, payments or distributions, and whose cover or certification block cites a grant, estate reference or personal representative. Money columns alone point to Finance, not this situation

a personal estate-plan archive whose manifest lists several mutually reinforcing members such as a will, codicil, trust instrument, power of attorney, advance directive, designation or registration confirmation. Only the manifest is inspected during the normal scan: “Archives should be inspected without being unpacked to disk.” Member facts are never copied to the archive or to one another

a structured signature-service, registry or adviser message whose sender and subject identify completion, filing or delivery of a named estate instrument and whose attachment metadata identifies that instrument. The message establishes only its own protected workflow; it does not supply the attachment's content, legal effect or current status
needs_llm: PRECONDITION: Legal protection is already active, P7 has run, and this schema still has no Legal fields. Protected material is excluded from cloud prompts by default; any permitted model review is local or explicitly authorized and redacted. The model may propose only template plausibility, group coherence or an outlier decision with exact citations, never legal advice or an instrument's validity, effect, status, parties, wishes or dispositive outcome
an unlabelled letter of wishes, funeral instruction or family letter whose estate or end-of-life purpose appears only in prose and which may be personal guidance rather than a legal instrument

whether two near-identical files are a draft, executed copy, codicil, restatement, revocation or unrelated template. A model may identify cited differences for review but must not declare which one is current or governing

whether an ambiguous use of will, living will, directive, trust, estate, attorney, agent or beneficiary describes a testamentary instrument, a health-care instrument, an account record, a lawsuit, an IT estate, or ordinary prose

whether a corpus holds the person's own estate documents or a practitioner's client matter. Matter-management structure, billing, work product and multiple clients point to legal.practice-matter-file; possession, a folder name or one firm letterhead decides nothing
a foreign-language, historical or unusual instrument whose functional roles are visible but whose document-kind vocabulary is not in the deployment's one injected jurisdiction catalogue

whether a mixed archive is one coherent estate-plan or administration packet when the manifest is incomplete, while retaining every member as its own file and leaving conflicting people, estates, accounts or instrument references visible
whether correspondence about a death or estate belongs to routine administration, an adversarial will contest, a tax filing, a financial account workflow, genealogy research, or no accepted situation
an OCR'd portal screenshot or photographed page whose visible content may be an executed estate instrument, an adviser checklist, a public sample form, a clinical order, or a finance portal

whether a trust certification, beneficiary form or account-registration document carries disjoint Legal and Finance evidence, without letting an account number, institution, beneficiary name or trust label count once for both schemas

handwritten or voice-derived wishes only after an explicit privacy and compute policy authorizes the relevant extraction. Without an authorized transcript or sufficient legible text, the correct result is abstention
never_alone: the words will, trust, estate, beneficiary, executor, probate, attorney, agent, directive, wishes, legacy or succession alone. Will is ordinary prose; estate describes property and IT systems; trust appears in finance and governance; beneficiary appears in insurance, retirement and research

a person's name, relationship word, death reference, address, asset description, account number or identifier-shaped token alone. None establishes a legal role, ownership, authority, entitlement or which person's plan the corpus holds

a signature, witness line, notarial seal, attestation block or electronic-signature certificate alone. Leases, affidavits, consents, school forms and commercial agreements carry the same execution furniture

a lawyer, notary, court, registry, hospital, insurer, bank, brokerage or adviser name alone. The organization can be an issuer, provider, counterparty, employer, citation, template publisher or sender of generic guidance

a medical treatment, resuscitation, capacity, care, proxy or patient term alone. A clinician order or provider proxy-access record is not an advance directive merely because it discusses end-of-life care or representation
an account, policy, pension, investment, premium, tax, asset or beneficiary term alone. An account statement and tax return can concern a trust or estate without being an estate-planning instrument

a death certificate, marriage certificate, birth certificate or other vital record merely because it appears in an estate packet. Registry structure makes it Identity material; grouping never rewrites its schema evidence

source_type or extension alone, including PDF, DOCX, image, OCR, spreadsheet, email, calendar, archive, presentation or opaque binary. 00 says to “treat the file extension as a routing signal rather than an assumption about meaning”
the words draft, final, current, signed, executed, revoked, certified or registered in a filename alone. A filename cannot establish legal status, version precedence or execution
a folder named Estate Plan, Wills, Trust, Probate, Family Documents or a person's name. Existing structure is context and user intent, not evidence that every descendant is an operative instrument
download-session membership or proximity to another estate document. “A session should never be treated as proof of topic”; it can retrieve candidates for review and never propagates a role or status

a calendar appointment with an estate adviser, a generic completion email or an attachment filename. A planned signing is not proof that an instrument was signed, and the message and attachment are separate files
missing EXIF, dense OCR or a platform-shaped PNG filename as proof of screenshot origin or legal content. Document scans, camera photos and downloaded samples share those properties

a bare date, year-shaped token, jurisdiction name or jurisdiction-specific form code. Date roles require narrow labelled evidence; jurisdiction remains an injected value and never a field or destination dimension

an unreadable, encrypted, damaged or unsupported file whose filename says Estate, Will or Trust. “Unreadable, encrypted, corrupted, or unsupported files should retain basic metadata and remain eligible for manual attachment to a user-created group, but the system should not infer a purpose from their filename alone”

work_types: property or financial power of attorney
health or welfare power of attorney
letter of wishes or funeral instruction
grouping_reasons: one estate-planning packet across a will, trust, powers of attorney, advance directive and beneficiary directions, but only when a manifest, direct cross-reference or user decision supports the packet. A shared person name or adviser is not enough

one instrument across its draft, executed copy, amendment, codicil, restatement, registration and revocation records, linked through direct parent references or the universal duplicate_family and version_family facts. Grouping must never assert which version governs

one trust across its deed, amendments, certifications and trustee records when the documents directly identify the same trust or a user confirms the group. An account titled to a trust may join without donating its Finance facts to the trust instrument

one personal estate administration across the grant, inventory, asset correspondence, accounts and distribution records when an explicit estate or grant reference supports membership. A deceased person's name alone cannot absorb every nearby document

one beneficiary or transfer direction as both a Finance account workflow and an estate-plan member. Multi-membership preserves both readings; neither schema copies names, roles, account facts or legal effect from the other

one advance directive across the holder's copy, provider-filed copy and registry or delivery confirmation through exact duplicates, version relationships or direct references. A medical chart mention does not inherit the directive's contents

a protected instrument can surface without any accepted group. 00 explicitly permits rare legal documents below normal group-size expectations, so protection never depends on fabricating an estate, family, adviser or folder branch

every group preserves file-level evidence: “The graph does not automatically copy those missing facts onto sparse files.” No member receives a person, role, asset, beneficiary, status, jurisdiction, instrument kind or path from its neighbours

template.why: Empty by binding contract and by privacy. Legal declares no fields under D1 and PR-6, so this template has no destination-eligible key and cannot smuggle estate, person, role, adviser, instrument kind, status, jurisdiction or year into a folder level. Independently, those labels would reveal exactly what protection is meant to hide. 00 requires, “Protected branches should have configurable redaction in the canvas and review screens.” It leaves disclosure under user control: “The user can choose whether names, previews, thumbnails, OCR text, or location data are shown.” The present recommendation is a flat, redacted protected area or preserved user-created structure; accepted packets may be reviewed without automatic depth. It is not time-first. Even if Legal fields later exist, the record-domain rule points away from chronological fragmentation: “For document and record domains, project, function, or subject usually comes before time because putting year first scatters related work across calendar folders.”

collides_with.signal: A beneficiary designation, transfer-on-death registration or trust-titled account form can be both an account workflow and a direction for assets at death. A labelled account descriptor with holdings, contribution or custodian structure points to investment and brokerage; completed beneficiary or owner-authorization sections, a trust or estate instrument reference and operative direction point here. One issuer, account number, beneficiary name or trust title cannot count for both; disjoint Finance and Legal evidence may still co-activate.

A health-and-welfare power of attorney, advance directive, guardianship instrument and provider proxy-access record all mention health decisions, representatives and patients. Operative appointment clauses, execution formalities, witnesses, notarization, revocation or legal-instrument headings point here; a provider or portal access workflow, patient-specific clinical record or care-plan structure with separately labelled patient and representative roles points to dependant health. Authority wording alone proves neither legal effect nor clinical access.

An advance directive or living will and a provider-authored medical order can both state treatment and resuscitation choices. A completed principal-or-agent legal instrument with execution or witness structure points here; a patient/provider block, clinician order and clinical-record workflow without an appointment instrument points to personal health records. End-of-life vocabulary alone decides neither, and both readings remain protected.

A will contest, probate dispute or fiduciary claim cites the same will, trust, estate and people as a planning or administration packet. An adversarial court caption, opposing parties, allegations and requested relief point to personal legal matters; a testamentary, trust, delegated-authority or advance-directive instrument, or a routine grant-and-account administration structure, points here. The words probate, estate or will alone decide nothing.

A trust deed and an ordinary deed, lease or signed agreement share recitals, numbered clauses, parties, signatures and notarization. Settlor, trustee and beneficiary roles with directions for holding or distributing property point here; landlord, tenant, premises, rent or a bilateral service obligation points to leases and agreements. The word deed, property, trust or signed alone cannot select either template.

The exact same wills, trusts, powers and probate papers may sit in a person's protected plan or in a practitioner's client matter. Multi-client matter identifiers, conflict checks, engagement records, billing, advice drafts and professional work product point to the practice situation; one household's instruments, direct personal-plan packet or user-confirmed personal administration points here. Possession, a law-firm name or a folder labelled Clients decides neither.

A life-insurance beneficiary designation is issued inside a policy workflow and also directs proceeds at death. Policy, coverage, premium or claim structure points to personal insurance; a completed beneficiary-direction and owner-authorization structure points here. An insurer name, policy number, beneficiary word or death reference alone cannot count for both, while disjoint Finance and Legal evidence may co-activate.

A trust or estate tax return and an estate-administration packet share estate names, assets, representatives and dates. A tax-authority form, labelled tax year, filing-entity block and computation schedules point to tax filings; instrument roles and execution, or a grant-linked inventory and account, point here. The words estate, trust, beneficiary or a year alone decide neither.

A death certificate or other vital record commonly accompanies probate and names the same person and family. Registry-issued civil-record structure with event details, certificate number and registrar points to core identity; a will, trust, grant, authority or estate-account structure points here. Packet membership and one shared name never transform the certificate into an estate-planning instrument.

A photographed or scanned will, trust or directive genuinely has page-capture geometry and OCR evidence. Page edges, perspective, scanner or camera metadata establish capture origin; testamentary, trust, authority or directive structure in the document content points here. Capture evidence may supply Photos facts but cannot lower protection or choose a capture-first destination.

An estate portal capture genuinely carries screen-origin evidence while its OCR exposes protected instrument names and workflow status. Display dimensions, capture software and interface chrome establish screenshot origin; completed legal-instrument structure visible on screen would point here. Missing EXIF, PNG format, portal labels or the word complete decide neither, and screen origin never overrides protection.

falls_through_to.why: The safe broad home when a Legal-protected estate instrument has no accepted packet, instrument family or user-approved structure. 00 defines it directly: “Protected Records may represent sensitive isolated material such as passport scans, medical documents, account statements, visas, legal forms, or credentials; it should normally remain local-only and must not cause filenames or content to be exposed in model prompts.” It is an opt-in residual candidate that may represent a file without moving it; it does not authorize automatic placement.

sensitivity_why: 00 places Legal on the safety path and states: “Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default, should not display raw content in general group summaries, and should not be moved automatically without a user policy that explicitly permits it.” Estate instruments can expose third-party identities, family relationships, medical wishes, incapacity planning, assets, account references, signatures and intended transfers. This row sets only potentially_sensitive. D2's authoritative ClassificationRecord keyed by file_id and content_hash, its injected P7 detector, and P7's handling-class vocabulary are not re-derived, populated or named here.
open_question: Three forks remain Joseph's. First, if D1's Legal deferral ever lifts, decide centrally whether subject-of-plan or estate, holder role, instrument kind, party roles, matter or grant reference, execution date, and supersession state exist as canonical fields at all; this template proposes none, and institution, client, record_type and creation_date cannot be repurposed for those roles. Second, decide whether estate planning and personal post-death administration remain one protected situation or split only after corpus evidence supports a separate template, and how P10 distinguishes a person's own records from practitioner custody without a holder-role field. Third, decide whether any Legal value may ever become a visible destination dimension: person, estate, beneficiary, adviser, medical-wish, instrument-status and matter labels all disclose protected content. Until those field, custody and display decisions are explicit, this row remains flat, treats jurisdiction terms as injected values, and never asks a model to rule on validity, capacity, entitlement, current effect or which instrument governs.
